name: Alveolar Soft Tissue Sarcoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Molecular Diagnostic Criteria for Alveolar Soft Tissue Sarcoma

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic alveolar pattern with nests of polygonal tumor cells separated by fibrovascular septa
Positive nuclear staining for TFE3 transcription factor
Detection of ASPSCR1-TFE3 gene fusion by molecular techniques (FISH, RT-PCR, or sequencing)
Slow-growing painless soft tissue mass typically in deep soft tissues of extremities or trunk

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological alveolar pattern plus either positive TFE3 immunostaining or molecular confirmation of ASPSCR1-TFE3 fusion
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of histology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular genetics due to overlap with other sarcomas.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Painless, slow-growing deep soft tissue mass
searchTerms: deep soft tissue swelling without pain

pathognomonic.symptomName: Characteristic alveolar histological pattern on biopsy
searchTerms: tissue sample showing small air sac structures
TFE3 protein detected in cell nuclei

common.symptomName: Metastatic lesions in lungs at diagnosis
searchTerms: cancer spread to lungs at diagnosis
tumor lesions in lungs when first found

common.symptomName: Mild functional impairment of affected limb
Occasional mild discomfort at tumor site
searchTerms: rare mild soreness at tumor site

occasional.symptomName: Weight loss related to advanced disease
searchTerms: weight loss due to advanced cancer

occasional.symptomName: Mild respiratory symptoms due to lung metastases
searchTerms: mild breathing problems from lung tumors
slight respiratory symptoms due to lung metastases
minor shortness of breath related to lung lesions
high blood calcium caused by tumor

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits secondary to brain metastases
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to brain spread
open skin wounds on tumor area

laboratory: Non-specific laboratory findings; no specific blood markers
Possible mild anemia in advanced disease
imaging: MRI showing well-defined soft tissue mass with high vascularity
other: Positive TFE3 nuclear immunostaining on tumor biopsy

distinguishingFeatures: Melanocytic marker positivity (HMB-45, Melan-A) in clear-cell sarcoma
Different gene fusion (EWSR1-ATF1) in clear-cell sarcoma
Positive epithelial markers (cytokeratins) in renal cell carcinoma
Clinical history of primary renal tumor

redFlags: Rapid increase in size of soft tissue mass
Presence of lung or brain metastases at diagnosis
